races.paceDynamic: Ten Sixty Six and Light The Night Up will engage early, with Ten Sixty Six likely to take them along at a steady gallop given the 1m4f trip. The prominent quartet of Box Clever, Spacewoman, Valkyrie Storm and Adba will create congestion behind the leaders, setting up potential traffic problems approaching the straight. With five hold-up horses (Galileo Charm, Jamie Sommers, Reem Rak, Laughterintherain) needing room late, this race strongly favours those able to secure clean early positions and kick clear before the cavalry charge arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Early Leaders Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ten Sixty Six or Light The Night Up can dictate fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady enough for one of them to have something left, while the prominent runners get first run on the hold-up brigade. This scenario rewards those who avoid the late scramble entirely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go too fast or fade approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The quartet sitting handy will have the perfect position to strike as the pace collapses, getting clear before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. Clean early positioning proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get caught in a pocket or check approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will benefit from the scrimmaging ahead but must hope for racing room when it matters. Only those with the best turns of foot will prevail.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Ten Sixty Six and Light The Night Up go off too fast and stop dramatically
scenarios.body: The entire field will come back to the closers, creating a sprint finish where class and turn of foot matter most. The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with maximum pace to run at.

races.paceDynamic: Phoenix Moon is the sole confirmed front runner in this small field of seven, meaning she'll get an uncontested lead without early pressure. With six hold-up horses behind her, the pace will be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing Phoenix Moon to dictate terms from the front. The hold-up brigade including Orbital Chime, Winchurch, and Beaming Light will need to overcome a tactical disadvantage in a slowly-run race. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any horse that can race prominently early, as the lack of pace pressure creates a significant tactical edge for those on or near the lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Moon jumps cleanly and establishes an easy lead without harassment
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian with Phoenix Moon controlling the gallop, making it difficult for the hold-up horses to generate enough late momentum. Despite being 0-7 on turf, her tactical advantage in a slowly-run race could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses can secure ideal racing room and the pace quickens sufficiently in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Orbital Chime or Winchurch get the perfect trip tracking the leaders before unleashing a telling finish. The sustained pace allows their superior finishing kicks to tell in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Returning Runner Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the long absence proves beneficial and Big Apple Jack or Ishe Worth Agamble show significant improvement
scenarios.body: Fresh legs and a potentially lenient handicap mark combine with the tactical setup to produce an upset. The slow pace suits their patient style but they need everything to fall perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Moon sets a more genuine gallop than expected, creating better opportunities for those tracking
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more even throughout, negating some of Phoenix Moon's tactical edge while still not being fast enough to fully suit the hold-up horses. King David or Beaming Light could benefit from this middle-ground scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Sea Her Excel and Bold Return will dispute the early lead with Saeculamation likely to sit just behind in third, creating a moderate tempo over the opening 3f. The pace will quicken approaching the 2f pole as the prominent trio come under pressure from the large field of hold-up horses led by Elashgar, Faithful Dream and In Denial. With 15 runners and most employing patient tactics, this sets up as a typical sprint handicap where the early leaders will come back to the field in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours horses with a finishing kick who can produce their best work in the final 1-2f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Kick Required
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves moderate and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge in the final 2f with stamina and a strong finish at premium. Hold-up horses with proven acceleration like Elashgar and Faithful Dream can unleash their kicks when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Her Excel and Bold Return establish a clear advantage and maintain momentum through the bend
scenarios.body: The early leaders resist the late charge by maintaining their rhythm and staying on strongly. Bold Return's recent 5f form suggests she has the pace to cope with this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is very moderate and no horse can quicken decisively in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of who can find the most in a slow-motion finish where class tells. Horses with higher ratings like Stock Market could emerge despite recent poor form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Bias Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground plays faster than expected and early pace proves advantageous
scenarios.body: The prominent runners maintain their positions throughout with the hold-up horses unable to make up sufficient ground. This scenario requires the track to be riding particularly quick.

races.paceDynamic: Layla Liz will lead from the gate with Master Of My Fate, Michaela's Boy, Grandlad and Smart Vision all wanting prominent positions within 2-3 lengths. The congestion behind the sole leader creates a moderate pace through halfway before the prominent quartet starts scrapping 2f out. This early positioning battle will disadvantage the hold-up horses (Muker, Nad Alshiba Green, Desert Cop, Intervention) who need splits that may not come in a short 5f dash. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader without getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Layla Liz gets an easy lead without early pressure from the prominent runners.
scenarios.body: She can control fractions and kick clear 2f out while the chasers are still organizing behind her. Her proven front-running ability at this distance gives her the tactical edge over horses fighting for position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Erupts
scenarios.trigger: If Master Of My Fate, Michaela's Boy and Smart Vision all press Layla Liz early.
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up a late charge from the better-handicapped hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble. Nad Alshiba Green and Nogo's Dream benefit most from this tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet creates a wall across the track entering the final 2f.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses as jockeys check their mounts, creating a messy finish where positioning luck trumps ability. Any horse finding a clean run benefits, regardless of rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If all prominent runners defer to Layla Liz and she sets pedestrian fractions.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from 2f out where the classiest horse wins regardless of tactics. Desert Cop's higher rating and Nad Alshiba Green's C&D form become decisive factors.

runners_data.comment: Absent since a 2024 campaign that featured a close second in the Ribblesdale
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since a 2024 campaign that ended with her coming up short in the Irish Oaks and Yorkshire Oaks; progressive earlier and went close in the Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot (1m4f) when bidding for a four-timer; could go well, provided she returns in good order.

runners_data.name: Alla Stella

runners_data.comment: One of two contestants who have been absent since 2024; check the betting
runners_data.spotlight: Best 2yo form when making the frame in Sandown Listed event and Curragh Group 3; one of two contestants who have been absent since 2024; needs improvement on ratings; market should offer further guidance.

runners_data.name: It's A Heartbeat

runners_data.comment: Irish filly who has very low mileage; may rate higher still; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Irish filly who has very low mileage; completed a Curragh double (maiden/handicap) last summer; reappearance effort in Cork Listed event (kept to 1m4f) suggests this drop back in trip is worth exploring; may rate higher still; interesting.

races.paceDynamic: That's Amore provides the only confirmed pace angle as the sole front runner, likely to dictate terms from the rail without meaningful pressure through the early stages. The four hold-up horses (See The Fire, Love Dynasty, Lava Stream, Alla Stella) will settle behind with It's A Heartbeat tracking in a prominent position. With minimal pace pressure expected, That's Amore can control fractions and potentially steal a march, while the hold-up brigade may face a tactical challenge if the pace becomes too sedate. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid getting caught behind a slow pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If That's Amore gets easy fractions and maintains her kick
scenarios.body: She controls the race unchallenged and has enough in reserve to resist late challengers on ground that suits. The hold-up horses are left with too much to do from the steady pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If See The Fire gets a clear run and finds her Group form
scenarios.body: The superior class horse overcomes the tactical disadvantage of the slow pace with a devastating late surge. Her proven Group credentials at this trip prove decisive against lesser opposition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Long Absence Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If the two long-absent horses (Lava Stream, Alla Stella) lack race fitness
scenarios.body: Their 500+ day layoffs prove costly in a competitive finish, allowing fresher rivals to capitalize. The race becomes a battle between the recent runners with sharper preparation.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Specialist
scenarios.trigger: If Love Dynasty handles the good ground better than expected
scenarios.body: Her previous soft/heavy ground form translates to these conditions and she finds improvement from the long break. The lightly-raced profile delivers an upset against more exposed rivals.

watchPoints.text: That's Amore breaks smartly and establishes clear lead - if unchallenged she can dictate ideal fractions
See The Fire gets trapped behind slow pace in final two furlongs - needs clear passage to utilize superior class
Lava Stream shows signs of ring-rustiness early - 612-day absence could prove telling despite past Group form
Love Dynasty handles good ground in opening stages - previous soft/heavy restriction may not apply
It's A Heartbeat tracks That's Amore closely - prominent position crucial if pace becomes pedestrian

races.paceDynamic: Macari and Just An Hour are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace over this staying trip. With only six runners, this creates a genuine speed duel that should set up an honest gallop throughout the 1m6f journey. The tempo will be solid rather than frantic, but the early pace battle between these two leaders will ensure no crawling early fractions. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalise on the inevitable weakening of the pace-setters in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Macari and Just An Hour engage in their expected pace duel from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for the closers who can pick up the pieces when the leaders weaken. Imperial Sovereign, Codiak, Spirit Of Jura and Rock N Roll Pinkie all have the tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Just An Hour Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Just An Hour can shake off Macari early and get first run on his rivals
scenarios.body: His proven 1m6f form and recent consistency will tell, with the lighter weight helping him stay strong to the line. The George Wood partnership has been reliable this season.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners go too hard early and tie each other up completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back with the strongest finisher prevailing in the final furlong. This scenario particularly suits Rock N Roll Pinkie who has shown good finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Macari Gets Tactical
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Dawes settles Macari better than expected and avoids the early duel
scenarios.body: The 109-day break could have freshened him up sufficiently to see out this trip under his claiming allowance. His earlier turf form gives him an outside chance.

watchPoints.text: Just An Hour and Macari will determine the entire complexion of this race - if they go too hard early, both become vulnerable
Codiak making his turf handicap debut after two AW wins - track conditions and surface change could catch him out
Imperial Sovereign has shown his best form on the all-weather recently, so monitor how he handles the return to turf
Macari returning after 109 days off with an inexperienced 5lb claimer - fitness and jockey inexperience could combine negatively
Rock N Roll Pinkie's recent return form suggests he's ready to strike, particularly if the pace sets up right for his closing style

races.paceDynamic: Shady Bay will take this field along from the front with minimal pressure, having shown clear front-running tendencies and registering a 1m2f double at this track last July. With only Glint Of Light capable of pressing early, the pace will be steady rather than demanding through the first half. The lack of genuine pace angles means Shady Bay can dictate terms and kick for home when ready. This sustainable tempo strongly favours prominent runners and those who can track the pace, disadvantaging the hold-up horses who need a strong gallop to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shady Bay Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Shady Bay reproduces his July form at this track and gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the race from flag to finish, quickening off a steady pace that suits his style perfectly. Glint Of Light and the prominent runners struggle to close the gap as the tempo doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Glint Of Light presses Shady Bay early and creates genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners duel through the middle stages, setting up a tactical finish where track position matters more than closing kicks. Solanna and the hold-up brigade find it difficult to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: Shady Bay goes too slowly early, allowing Solanna and Kurios Lady to mount late challenges from their hold-up positions. The race becomes a sprint finish where the fresher closers can strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromises All
scenarios.trigger: If Shady Bay fails to fire after his long break and no clear pace emerges
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no obvious tempo, creating a scrambled finish where any horse can win on the day. Form and ratings become less relevant in a tactical lottery.

watchPoints.text: Shady Bay's fitness after 174 days off will determine if he can sustain his front-running style through the final furlong
Glint Of Light's early positioning is crucial - if she doesn't press Shady Bay the race becomes uncompetitive
Solanna's early position with new jockey David Egan may differ from her usual hold-up style under Rossa Ryan
Kurios Lady needs to be ridden aggressively by Rossa Ryan to overcome the likely steady pace
The small field size means any horse getting outpaced early will struggle to recover in time
